verdict.rationale: Brave documents an in-browser playground for trying API endpoints with their parameters, alongside per-endpoint API reference pages and curl examples. This covers the core of exploring and running requests. It is unclear whether the reference itself is interactive, as opposed to a separate playground, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: evidence that the API reference pages themselves embed runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Try out the Brave Search API endpoints in your browser. Select an endpoint to see the available parameters
